mechanism: Establish a complete ensemble and its audience or work field, bring two central contributors into a shared action, isolate one lead long enough for a complete proof phrase while the ensemble remains spatially implied, then reintroduce the co-lead and finish on a wider synchronized group state.

invariants.rule: Establish the full ensemble and surrounding response field before isolating a lead.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening close hides the ensemble stakes.

invariants.rule: Bring two central contributors into one shared action before ownership narrows.
invariants.ablation_failure: An immediate solo gives no handoff.

invariants.rule: Give one lead enough uninterrupted screen ownership to complete a proof phrase.

invariants.purpose: Returns focus from individual to partnership.

invariants.rule: Finish wide enough to show the ensemble responding in one synchronized state.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.
